correctness.rationale: Exact rational computations in Q(eps), eps^2+eps+1=0, from all 57 printed line forms independently reproduced the 453 singular points with multiplicity distribution n2=252,n3=108,n4=72,n8=21. All 1596 line pairs were accounted for; incidence with 21 eightfold points gave profile 12 lines at five, nine at four and 36 at two. Exact projective normalization matched the 12 lines with x,y,z axes plus nine x+eps^i y+eps^j z=0. A projectivity preserving H57 preserves singular multiplicities and so the original Hesse 12, proving Stab(H57)<=Stab(H)=G216. Covariance of the incidence-based Lambda_(2,2) operation gives reverse inclusion. The known Hessian group action is verified against Artebani–Dolgachev Proposition4.1, and the combinatorial recovery is exhaustively exact (not a sample).

An earlier arrangement classification could give the same stabilizer under a different name.
